posts.text:
语言模型能否制作出比视频模型更优秀的视频呢？

大型语言模型如今能够制作动态图形、使用代码进行视频编辑，甚至还能驱动 Blender 软件来构建 3D 场景。那么，大型语言模型能否与视频生成模型竞争呢？

我们将 
@OpenAI
 提供的 GPT-6.2 Astra 模型纳入了测试之中。目前这款模型在 AA-3D 领域排名第一。

ElevenLabs' Scribe v3 ranks #2 on the AA-WER Index for non-streaming speech-to-text at 1.95% WER, improving on Scribe v2 (2.18%)

In our independent benchmarks, it sits behind Alibaba's Fun-Realtime-ASR-preview (1.73%) and just ahead of Microsoft AI's MAI-Transcribe-2 (2.04%).

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.name: Artificial Analysis

Carbon is the highest-priced model ($4/$20 per 1M input/output tokens), followed by Neon ($3/$15) and Hydrogen ($1.50/$7.50). At low effort, Carbon performs the

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.name: Artificial Analysis
posts.text: Carbon performs best on CritPt (a graduate-level physics evaluation) but loses out in agentic research and knowledge work. This is driven by its limited improvement at higher reasoning levels compared to Neon and Hydrogen.
